ja83:1.1: He is certainly a friend with seven steps,
ja83:1.2: But with twelve he is a companion true,
ja83:1.3: With a month or a fortnight he is (like) kin,
ja83:1.4: More than that he is just the same as my self,
ja83:1.5: How would I, the cause of my own happiness,
ja83:1.6: Abandon my long time friend Kāḷakaṇṇi?
